title: More milk is the CDC sample of two words joined by age 2
summary: By a second birthday, the CDC communication sheet includes at least two words together, and the sample phrase is more milk.
body: The 2-year CDC sheet uses more milk as the sample of a child joining at least two words. The phrase pairs a request with a drink. It is a combination, not a count of how many items the child can name. A different entry on that sheet is pointing to a bear in a book when asked where the bear is. This card is only the joined phrase. The sheet was written for the United States, and a form from another country can place that step at a different age.
